A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Kaleesh''' served as a Battlelord of the [[Dire Skulls]] pirate gang aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. In [[3627 BBY]], he worked with the [[the Brothers]] enslaver organization to retrieve shipment data that had been intercepted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, he believed that by killing their representative, he could make a bid for control of the Dire Skulls. He was then slain in the ensuing fight, ending his hopes of leading the Dire Skulls.<ref name="Respect" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaleesh Battlelord appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''. He is featured in the secondary and heroic quest "A Matter of Respect" for Imperial-aligned players.<ref name="Respect" />
